newsitem.title: USA: Fire idles compressor on Koch Gateway gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Fire idles compressor on Koch Gateway gas pipeline.

text.p: Koch Industries shut down a compressor on its Gateway natural gas pipeline system in Carthage, Texas following a fire on Monday, a company spokesman said.
"We've taken it off line," the spokesman said of the Carthage number 1 compressor, one of several located along a section of the pipeline passing through east Texas.
Traders said the outage could curtail 55 million cubic feet per day.
Additional details were not immediately available.
